confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparable prices; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are least certain because they vary widely by area, lead time and demand. Cocktail (about 2.8x beer) and wine_glass (about 1.1x beer) use a beer-relative basis because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value comes from a web search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page, and the 15 October figure could not be corroborated or confirmed as posted, so verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against the supplied Porto, Berlin and Florence prices: all directly comparable anchors sit above Porto, most restaurant and hotel anchors sit below Florence, and hostel rates sit above all three comparables given Lisbon's summer hostel demand.
